title: वर्ष बंद
caption: हेमाच्या सीएला असे आकडे पाहिजेत जे बदलणार नाहीत. लुमी तिची गोष्ट सांगते.
linkedin_text: At the end of the financial year, ScoreMyBiz previews the year's sales, costs, profit and closing figures. Closing it locks all twelve months and the next year opens from the closing figures. It can be reopened. It is not a tax filing; the CA still prepares those.

cast.hema: Hema, a middle-aged Indian woman who runs a stationery shop, in a green cotton saree and round glasses

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a tidy stationery shop with notebooks stacked behind her, a warm smile.
